title: LEARN BEFORE YOU JUDGE: PROGRESSIVE KNOWLEDGE-TO-DECISION ALIGNMENT FOR EXPLAINABLE HATEFUL MEME DETECTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a progressive knowledge-to-decision alignment method for multimodal large language models to detect and explain hateful memes. While it uses datasets that contain hate speech against various protected groups (including religious groups), it does not specifically focus on evaluating or benchmarking religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
